text:
Predicates:
RankedHighly(x) ::: x is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
ActivePlayer(x) ::: x is one of the most active players in major tennis.
LostToIga(x) ::: x lost to Iga Świątek at Roland Garros 2022.
FemalePlayer(x) ::: x is a female tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
MalePlayer(x) ::: x is a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
AtRolandGarras2022(x) ::: x participated in Roland Garros 2022.
CocoGauff(x) ::: x is Coco Gauff.
Question:
CocoGauff is at Roland Garros 2022.
Premises:
∀x (RankedHighly(x) → ActivePlayer(x)) ::: If someone is ranked highly, then they are an active player.
∀x (LostToIga(x) → RankedHighly(x)) ::: Everyone who lost to Iga Świątek at Roland Garros 2022 is ranked highly.
∀x (FemalePlayer(x) → LostToIga(x)) ::: All female players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Iga Świątek.
∀x (AtRolandGarras2022(x)) → (FemalePlayer(x) ∨ MalePlayer(x)) ::: All players at Roland Garros 2022 are either female or male.
∀x (MalePlayer(x) ∧ AtRolandGarras2022(x)) → LostToRafaelNadal(x) ::: All male players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Rafael Nadal.
(∀x ((RankedHighly(x) ∨ LostToRafaelNadal(x))) ∧ CocoGauff(x)) → ¬MalePlayer(x) ::: If Coco Gauff is ranked highly or lost to Rafael Nadal, then she is not a male player.
Conclusion:
AtRolandGarras2022(cocoGauff) ::: Coco Gauff is at Roland Garros 2022.
